As preparations for the next high season, we are looking to relocate some of our fleet to Auckland. These are all self-contained campervans, however it does not come equiped with cooking equipment or linen. They will be equipped with a bed base and mattress. The picture is just as a rough example of sizing of the vehicles used. Depending what is available, vehicles can be Diesel or Petrol and Automatic or Manual transmission. For diesel vehicles, Road User Charge (RUC, Diesel tax) will be calculated upon return, $0.08 per km driven. No bedding or cooking equipment included. Vehicles have a bedbase + mattress.

Terms and conditions: https://www.trekcampers.com/nz/terms-and-conditions
